nodes.label: Eliminating Waterfalls (Section 1, async)
nodes.rationale: Waterfalls are the #1 performance killer; each sequential await adds full network latency.

nodes.label: Bundle Size Optimization (Section 2, bundle)
nodes.rationale: Reducing initial bundle size improves Time to Interactive and Largest Contentful Paint.

nodes.label: Server-Side Performance (Section 3, server)
nodes.rationale: Optimizing server-side rendering and data fetching eliminates server-side waterfalls and reduces response times.

nodes.label: Client-Side Data Fetching (Section 4, client)
nodes.rationale: Automatic deduplication and efficient data fetching patterns reduce redundant network requests.

nodes.label: Re-render Optimization (Section 5, rerender)
nodes.rationale: Reducing unnecessary re-renders minimizes wasted computation and improves UI responsiveness.

nodes.label: Rendering Performance (Section 6, rendering)
nodes.rationale: Optimizing the rendering process reduces the work the browser needs to do.

nodes.label: JavaScript Performance (Section 7, js)
nodes.rationale: Micro-optimizations for hot paths can add up to meaningful improvements.

nodes.label: Advanced Patterns (Section 8, advanced)
nodes.rationale: Advanced patterns for specific cases that require careful implementation.

nodes.label: Rule File Template (_template.md)
nodes.rationale: Standard structure for new rules: title/impact frontmatter, incorrect vs correct examples, references.

nodes.label: Do Not Put Effect Events in Dependency Arrays
nodes.rationale: Effect Event identity changes every render; adding it to deps re-runs the effect every render.
nodes.norm_label: do not put effect events in dependency arrays

nodes.label: Store Event Handlers in Refs
nodes.rationale: Stable subscriptions: keep callback in a ref so effects don't re-subscribe on callback changes.

nodes.label: Initialize App Once, Not Per Mount
nodes.rationale: useEffect([]) re-runs on remount and twice in dev; use a module-level guard for app-wide init.
nodes.norm_label: initialize app once, not per mount

nodes.label: useEffectEvent for Stable Callback Refs
nodes.rationale: Access latest values in callbacks without adding them to dependency arrays; prevents effect re-runs and stale closures.

nodes.label: Prevent Waterfall Chains in API Routes
nodes.rationale: Start independent operations immediately in API routes and Server Actions, even before awaiting them.
nodes.norm_label: prevent waterfall chains in api routes

nodes.label: Check Cheap Conditions Before Async Flags
nodes.rationale: Evaluate cheap synchronous guards first so the async flag call is skipped on the cold path.
nodes.norm_label: check cheap conditions before async flags

nodes.label: Defer Await Until Needed
nodes.rationale: Move await operations into the branches where they're used to avoid blocking unused code paths.

nodes.label: Dependency-Based Parallelization
nodes.rationale: For operations with partial dependencies, use better-all to start each task at the earliest possible moment.

nodes.label: Promise.all() for Independent Operations
nodes.rationale: Execute independent async operations concurrently to collapse N round trips into one.

nodes.label: Strategic Suspense Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Trade-off: faster initial paint vs potential layout shift; share the fetch promise across components so only one fetch occurs.

nodes.label: Prefer Statically Analyzable Paths
nodes.rationale: Hidden or composed paths force bundlers to widen file traces, causing larger bundles, slower builds and worse cold starts.

nodes.label: Avoid Barrel File Imports
nodes.rationale: Tree-shaking doesn't help when a library is marked external; direct imports cut 200-800ms import cost per cold start.

nodes.label: Conditional Module Loading
nodes.rationale: Load large data or modules only when a feature is activated; typeof window check prevents bundling for SSR.

nodes.label: better-all Library
nodes.rationale: Automatically maximizes parallelism for partially dependent async tasks (github.com/shuding/better-all).

nodes.label: Use Explicit Conditional Rendering
nodes.rationale: Explicit ternary operators (? :) prevent rendering literal 0 or NaN when a falsy condition passes through && — && leaks falsy values (0, NaN) into the DOM. Impact: LOW.

nodes.label: CSS content-visibility for Long Lists
nodes.rationale: content-visibility: auto defers off-screen rendering; with 1000 messages the browser skips layout/paint for ~990 off-screen items (~10x faster initial render). contain-intrinsic-size reserves space to prevent scroll jump. Impact: HIGH.

nodes.label: Hoist Static JSX Elements
nodes.rationale: Extracting static JSX to module scope avoids re-creating the element tree on every render — especially valuable for large static SVG nodes. With React Compiler enabled, manual hoisting is unnecessary. Impact: LOW.

nodes.label: Prevent Hydration Mismatch Without Flickering
nodes.rationale: For client-only values (localStorage, cookies), a synchronous inline script updates the DOM before React hydrates — avoiding both SSR breakage (localStorage undefined on server) and post-hydration flicker. Useful for theme toggles, preferences, and auth state. Impact: MEDIUM.

nodes.label: Suppress Expected Hydration Mismatches
nodes.rationale: Some server/client differences (random IDs, dates, locale/timezone formatting) are expected; suppressHydrationWarning silences noisy warnings for these only — must not be used to hide real bugs or overused. Impact: LOW-MEDIUM.

nodes.label: Use React DOM Resource Hints
nodes.rationale: React DOM preloading APIs (prefetchDNS, preconnect, preload, preloadModule, preinit, preinitModule) let server components start loading critical resources before the client even receives the HTML, reducing load time. Impact: HIGH.

nodes.label: Use defer or async on Script Tags
nodes.rationale: Scripts without defer/async block HTML parsing, delaying FCP and TTI. defer downloads in parallel and preserves order (DOM-dependent scripts); async executes when ready (independent scripts like analytics). In Next.js prefer next/script with strategy. Impact: HIGH.
nodes.norm_label: use defer or async on script tags

nodes.label: Optimize SVG Precision
nodes.rationale: Reducing SVG coordinate precision (e.g. 1 decimal place) decreases file size; optimal precision depends on viewBox size. Automate with SVGO (--precision=1 --multipass). Impact: LOW.

nodes.label: Use useTransition Over Manual Loading States
nodes.rationale: useTransition provides built-in isPending state instead of manual isLoading flags: pending state resets even if the transition throws, keeps the UI responsive, and new transitions cancel pending ones. Impact: LOW.
nodes.norm_label: use usetransition over manual loading states

nodes.label: Defer State Reads to Usage Point
nodes.rationale: Don't subscribe to dynamic state (searchParams, localStorage) when it is only read inside callbacks — read it on demand to avoid unnecessary re-renders. Impact: MEDIUM.
nodes.norm_label: defer state reads to usage point

nodes.label: Narrow Effect Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Primitive dependencies (user.id) instead of objects (user) minimize effect re-runs; for derived state, compute the boolean outside the effect so it re-runs only on a boolean transition, not every intermediate value. Impact: LOW.

nodes.label: Calculate Derived State During Rendering
nodes.rationale: If a value can be computed from current props/state, derive it during render instead of storing it in state via effects — avoids redundant renders and state drift; never set state in effects solely in response to prop changes. Impact: MEDIUM.

nodes.label: Subscribe to Derived State
nodes.rationale: Subscribe to derived boolean state (useMediaQuery) instead of continuous values (useWindowWidth) to reduce re-render frequency — re-renders only when the boolean flips, not on every pixel change. Impact: MEDIUM.

nodes.label: Use Functional setState Updates
nodes.rationale: Functional updater form (setItems(curr => ...)) prevents stale closures, eliminates state from dependency arrays, and creates stable callback references. React Compiler can optimize some cases but functional updates remain recommended for correctness. Impact: MEDIUM.

nodes.label: Use Lazy State Initialization
nodes.rationale: Passing a function to useState (useState(() => build())) runs the expensive initializer only once; without it the initializer runs on every render. Not needed for primitives or cheap literals. Impact: MEDIUM.

nodes.label: Extract Default Non-primitive Parameter Value from Memoized Component to Constant
nodes.rationale: Inline default parameter values (onClick = () => {}) create new references every render, breaking memo()'s strict equality comparison; extracting the default to a module constant restores memoization. Impact: MEDIUM.
nodes.norm_label: extract default non-primitive parameter value from memoized component to constant

nodes.label: Extract to Memoized Components
nodes.rationale: Extracting expensive work into memoized components lets parents early-return before computation. With React Compiler enabled, manual memo()/useMemo() is not necessary. Impact: MEDIUM.

nodes.label: Put Interaction Logic in Event Handlers
nodes.rationale: Side effects triggered by a user action belong in the event handler; modeling the action as state + effect makes effects re-run on unrelated changes and can duplicate the action. Impact: MEDIUM.
nodes.norm_label: put interaction logic in event handlers

nodes.label: Don't Define Components Inside Components
nodes.rationale: A component defined inside another creates a new type every render, so React fully remounts it — destroying state, re-running effects, recreating DOM. Symptoms: input focus loss per keystroke, animations restarting, scroll reset. Pass props instead. Impact: HIGH.

nodes.label: Do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in useMemo
nodes.rationale: useMemo's hook call and dependency comparison can cost more than the simple primitive expression itself — wrapping is wasted computation on every render. Impact: LOW-MEDIUM.
nodes.norm_label: do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in usememo

nodes.label: Split Combined Hook Computations
nodes.rationale: Independent tasks with different dependencies should be split into separate hooks — a combined hook recomputes all tasks when any dependency changes. Same applies to unrelated effects. React Compiler may handle some cases. Impact: MEDIUM.

nodes.label: Use Transitions for Non-Urgent Updates
nodes.rationale: Mark frequent, non-urgent state updates with startTransition so they don't block user input (e.g. scroll position tracking). Impact: MEDIUM.

nodes.label: Use useDeferredValue for Expensive Derived Renders
nodes.rationale: The deferred value lags behind the input update, letting React prioritize the input and render the expensive result when idle. Must wrap the computation in useMemo keyed on the deferred value, or it still runs every render. Impact: MEDIUM.
nodes.norm_label: use usedeferredvalue for expensive derived renders

nodes.label: React Compiler
nodes.rationale: When enabled, the React Compiler automatically memoizes, hoists static JSX, and optimizes dependency tracking — making manual memo()/useMemo() hoisting and some dependency tuning unnecessary.

nodes.label: CSS content-visibility
nodes.rationale: content-visibility: auto skips layout and paint for off-screen items; paired with contain-intrinsic-size to preserve space.

nodes.label: suppressHydrationWarning
nodes.rationale: React DOM attribute that silences hydration warnings for expected server/client differences only — not a tool to hide real bugs.

nodes.label: useTransition / startTransition
nodes.rationale: Concurrent React mechanism that marks non-urgent state updates as transitions so the UI stays responsive; useTransition adds built-in isPending; newer transitions cancel pending ones.

nodes.label: useDeferredValue
nodes.rationale: Hook that returns a lagging value so input updates win and expensive derived renders happen when the thread is idle.

nodes.label: React DOM Resource Hints
nodes.rationale: React DOM preloading API family: prefetchDNS, preconnect, preload, preloadModule, preinit, preinitModule — each tuned for a different resource timing need.

nodes.label: Talleres Médicos en Hospitales (proceso maestro)
nodes.rationale: Proceso ASK-CEM-DDP-001 de la Coordinación de Educación Médica para promocionar los dispositivos médicos Asokam/Lefarma ante el personal de quirófano. Se compone de 5 fases (material, selección de hospitales, viáticos, impartición, evaluación). La meta anual se fija en Nº hospitales × 1.5 talleres, con cuotas de al menos 64 talleres/mes por gerencia (IMSS y Descentralizados) y 4 hospitales/6 talleres por especialista por semana; el programa se revisa trimestralmente y se actualiza ante nuevos acuerdos SIA.

nodes.label: Proceso de Ventas IMSS (proceso maestro)
nodes.rationale: Proceso ASK-VEN-DPD-001 estructurado en ciclo Planea-Ejecuta-Verifica-Mejora (mensual/semanal). Los objetivos de desplazamiento deben estar autorizados por Dirección Corporativa antes del año y sirven de base para comisiones; el cumplimiento del plan de trabajo debe superar el 90% (verificado vía GPS) y el personal activo al cierre de mes debe ser al menos el 80% para que Gerencia General/Gerente IMSS cobren comisión. Variante descentralizada en ASK-VEN-DPD-002.

nodes.label: Plan anual
nodes.rationale: Documento rector que recoge objetivos, estrategias y planes de acción acordados en la planeación estratégica de la alta dirección; de él derivan las metas de ventas/desplazamiento (ASK-VEN-FOR-001), el plan de trabajo mensual de los ejecutivos y la programación anual de talleres médicos (ASK-CEM-FOR-003).

nodes.label: Productos Nuevos vs Tradicionales (criterio COFEPRIS)
nodes.rationale: Definición compartida en todos los instructivos de Ventas: producto NUEVO = patente vigente y registro sanitario COFEPRIS menor a 8 años; TRADICIONAL = registro mayor a 8 años. Separa las metas de ventas/desplazamiento en pesos y piezas en ASK-VEN-FOR-001.

nodes.label: CPM (Consumo Promedio Mensual)
nodes.rationale: Indicador de demanda por unidad médica que los ejecutivos monitorean (propio y de competencia) para gestionar cartas de creación/incremento de CPM y detectar unidades de consumo potencial en el plan de trabajo.

nodes.label: App Control AT&T (plataforma móvil de visitas)
nodes.rationale: Aplicación móvil (v1.35) autorizada por Asokam para registrar inicio/fin de cada visita con GPS; el Monitorista GPS descarga su reporte semanal (lunes/viernes) que alimenta el indicador de cumplimiento del plan de trabajo. Es obligatorio reportar en ella según el PNO.
nodes.norm_label: app control at&t (plataforma movil de visitas)

nodes.label: Microsoft Forms (captura electrónica de campo)
nodes.rationale: Plataforma donde el Ejecutivo de Ventas captura el Reporte de Visitas Médicas (cada visita) y donde registra la propuesta/aceptación de talleres médicos; el Auxiliar Administrativo de Educación Médica descarga diariamente los resultados para actualizar bases de datos e indicadores.

nodes.source_file: lefarma.docs/apps/educacion-medica/vault/Instructivos/Preparación y Autorización de Material de Talleres Médicos.md

nodes.label: Pareto 70/30 (criterio de priorización de hospitales)
nodes.source_file: lefarma.docs/apps/educacion-medica/vault/Instructivos/Elaboración del Concentrado Anual de Talleres Médicos.md
nodes.rationale: Criterio de selección: se visitan los hospitales de venta directa que concentran el 70% de la demanda anestésica estimada; el 30% restante no se visita. Complementa otros criterios (distancia/costos de traslado, tipo de hospital, SIA, índice de inseguridad).

nodes.label: SIA (Servicio Integral de Anestesia)
nodes.source_file: lefarma.docs/apps/educacion-medica/vault/Instructivos/Elaboración del Concentrado Anual de Talleres Médicos.md
nodes.rationale: Segmento clave de la base de hospitales: separa hospitales con SIA (se visitan) de venta directa; los acuerdos comerciales SIA pueden disparar talleres adicionales durante el año.

nodes.label: Cálculo de anestesias por hospital
nodes.rationale: Estimación de demanda anestésica: AT = NQ × 2.5 × 250 (quirófanos × cirugías/día × días laborables), AG = AT × 30%, AR = AT × 70%, AE = AR × 35%, AS = AR × 45%, MO = AR × 2%, MNO = AR × 18%. Es el insumo cuantitativo del Pareto 70/30 para priorizar hospitales.

nodes.rationale: Un solo JWT en localStorage (authStore); todas las apps leen del mismo store y el login en cualquier app autentica en todas. Por diseño, no es un bug.

nodes.label: Preservación de return-URL en RequireAuth
nodes.rationale: La remediación PR2 (PR2.R1–R3) preservó la return-URL porque el guard de Authentication Guard exige conservarla: RequireAuth ahora lleva ?return=${encodeURIComponent(from)} vía useLocation(); la violación C2 se propagó también a ProtectedRoute y GastosSubtreeIndex.

nodes.label: Modelo de navegación corregido (/CxP/ prefix)
nodes.rationale: Modelo corregido: /CxP/ redirige, /CxP/login global 2 pasos, /CxP/hub launcher, /CxP/gastos/ subtree con login 3 pasos y preservación de gastos como capability de primera clase en specs.

nodes.rationale: Cada artefacto SDD del cambio se persiste en Engram con topic_key sdd/gastos-migration/* (proposal 133, design 135, tasks 141, apply-progress 143, verify-report 149) para trazabilidad entre sesiones; el filesystem tasks.md es la fuente de verdad del estado de tareas.

nodes.label: GastosRoutes reusable route module
nodes.rationale: Single module of relative <Route> children mounted in both builds (root byte-identical, shell under /CxP/gastos); variant 'root'|'subtree' gates the unauth index (Hero vs redirect-to-login); root-build regression is the core hazard so every path including <Navigate to> is relative. Chosen over routes factory and two parallel defs (~30-route drift).

nodes.label: RequireAuth subtree-aware auth guard
nodes.rationale: loginPath prop + <Navigate> (shell is a single bundle so Navigate works, replacing foundation's window.location.href); checks AUTH ONLY, never context; return URL preserved via ?return=.

nodes.label: Config-driven Login (2-step global / 3-step Gastos)
nodes.rationale: One component with requireContextSelection + redirectTo props; avoids duplicating the 600-line form and fragile URL↔behavior coupling; redirectTo replaces hard-coded navigate('/dashboard').

nodes.label: BaseAppRoutes shell navigation rework
nodes.rationale: / becomes <Navigate> (auth→/hub, unauth→/login), /login added OUTSIDE RequireAuth, /hub→<Home/>, Gastos subtree mounted under gastos; blast radius 2 files + 1 registry line.

nodes.label: Static App Registry (_registry.ts)
nodes.rationale: Code-level registry, no backend call for the launcher; adding an app is code-only; gastos flipped from disabled to enabled.

nodes.label: Return-URL preservation (?return=)
nodes.rationale: PR2 remediation: <Navigate to={loginPath} replace/> dropped the return URL, violating the Authentication Guard spec. Fix: <Navigate to={`${loginPath}?return=${encodeURIComponent(from)}`} replace/> via useLocation(); query-param form because Login already consumes ?return= with a /CxP/-scoped open-redirect guard.

nodes.label: PermissionGuard blockedPath parameterization
nodes.rationale: C1 remediation: routing tests mocked PermissionGuard, leaving the blockedPath parameterization unobservable; new focused unit test exercises the REAL component (root default /bloqueado, subtree override /gastos/bloqueado, permission-satisfied renders children).

nodes.label: Lint baseline 181/160/21 (pre-existing debt)
nodes.rationale: Pre-existing cross-cutting lint debt identical across changes — zero regression by design; cleanup is out of scope.

nodes.label: gastos-migration verification PASS
nodes.rationale: Re-verification after C1+C2 remediation: both CRITICALs CLOSED, 21/21 tasks, 56/56 tests, both builds exit 0, 30/30 spec scenarios COMPLIANT, lint zero-regression; next step sdd-archive.

nodes.label: Chained PR slices (feature-branch-chain)
nodes.rationale: 750-1150 estimated lines exceeds the 400-line review budget (High) → PR1→PR2→PR3 chained slices.

nodes.label: Two env-driven builds via BASE_URL_PATH
nodes.rationale: Two builds from one codebase (root Gastos + /CxP/ shell), each IIS virtual app points to its own dist; vite.config.ts + App.tsx basename already implement env-driven base+basename so the root build stays untouched; same origin → shared localStorage → SSO free.

nodes.label: App tree selection on import.meta.env.BASE_URL
nodes.rationale: App.tsx renders <BaseAppRoutes> when BASE_URL === '/CxP/' else <AppRoutes>; one tree per build → no route-path collisions.

nodes.label: Same-origin localStorage SSO
nodes.rationale: Both builds share one origin → shared localStorage (accessToken, user) makes cross-app SSO automatic with no re-login.

nodes.label: Auth/api relocation to shared/ (shims → codemod)
nodes.rationale: 63 import statements across ~55 files; Phase 1a moves files + one-line export * shims (green), Phase 1b codemods imports and deletes shims; big-bang would exceed the 800-line review budget.

nodes.label: RequireAuth full-page redirect guard
nodes.rationale: window.location.href = '/login?return=' + encodeURIComponent(path) to the EXISTING root login (navigate cannot cross root↔/CxP/ bundles); Login honors ?return= safelisted to /CxP/ (open-redirect guard); no context-selection blocking.

nodes.label: Sibling-aware codemod regex (process lesson)
nodes.rationale: Gate regex missed sibling-relative imports (./authStore, ./api); deleting shims broke 7 sibling consumers surfaced by npm test; future codemods must use a sibling-aware regex; actual scope 62 files vs ~55 estimated.

nodes.label: Chained PR slices (feature-branch-chain)
nodes.rationale: ~1250 estimated lines exceeds the 400-line budget (High) → PR0→PR1a→PR1b→PR2 chained slices.

nodes.label: Canonical specs promoted to source of truth
nodes.rationale: Per the 'If Main Spec Does NOT Exist' OpenSpec convention, the three delta specs became the PERMANENT source of truth in openspec/specs/ (3 NEW capabilities, 15 NEW requirements).
nodes.norm_label: canonical specs promoted to source of truth

nodes.label: multi-app-foundation verification PASS WITH WARNINGS
nodes.rationale: 28/28 tasks; 22/23 scenarios COMPLIANT (1 PARTIAL = pre-existing lint debt, zero regression); all 5 design decisions honored; 21/21 tests; both builds exit 0; codemod gate 0 hits; Gastos root build provably unchanged.

nodes.label: App Routing capability (app-routing)
nodes.rationale: Canonical spec updated by nav-reorg (shell moved to root, Gastos renamed CxP): Vite asset base, React Router 7 basename, auth guard, static app registry, mountable app subtrees.

nodes.label: Authentication Guard (RequireAuth)
nodes.rationale: Guard redirects to a per-subtree login destination while preserving the return URL; checks authentication ONLY, never context selection; permission checks preserved under subtree mounting.

nodes.label: Static App Registry
nodes.rationale: Code-level registry module; shell SHALL NOT query backend permissions for the launcher; cxp and rh entries enabled; adding an entry is code-only.

nodes.label: Global Login Route
nodes.rationale: Authenticates credentials + password+domain only, no context selection, redirects to hub on success.

nodes.label: Per-App Login Route Pattern
nodes.rationale: Each app subtree exposes its own login at /{app}/login, independent of the global login; may collect app-specific context.

nodes.label: Root Deployment Path (Vite base + basename)
nodes.rationale: Assets resolve relative to / and routing treats / as root; deep links reload without 404. Foundation-era version was the /CxP/ IIS virtual application prefix.

nodes.label: Base App capability (base-app)
nodes.rationale: Minimum shell (launcher + profile); excludes admin UI; MUST NOT assume context selection.

nodes.label: Authenticated Shell Layout
nodes.rationale: Shell with primary nav + content region, reachable only via RequireAuth. Gastos-migration delta: shell home moved to /CxP/hub, index becomes a redirect.

nodes.label: Home Launcher
nodes.rationale: Default landing listing registry apps; empty registry renders gracefully. Gastos-migration delta: launcher lives at /CxP/hub.

nodes.label: Frontend Test Infrastructure capability (frontend-test-infra)
nodes.rationale: npm test runner, browser-like DOM for RTL, API independence (no backend), initial smoke coverage (login + Gastos dashboard), build/lint preservation; prerequisite for safe relocation.

nodes.label: Vitest + RTL + jsdom test runner
nodes.rationale: vi.mock('@/shared/api') at the test boundary; no MSW (unjustified for 2 smoke tests; revisit as the suite grows).

nodes.label: Gastos App capability (gastos-app)
nodes.rationale: First app under the corrected nav model: subtree at /CxP/gastos/ with its own MainLayout (not the shell layout), Dashboard landing gated by auth only, three-step login, cross-app SSO, reusable GastosRoutes module.

nodes.label: Gastos Three-Step Login
nodes.rationale: Steps: credentials, password+domain, empresa/sucursal/area context; step 3 is Gastos-ONLY (corrects the foundation's inverse claim); session not finalized until step 3.

nodes.label: Cross-App Single Sign-On
nodes.rationale: Within the shell build (single origin), Gastos shares the session established by the global login; hub→gastos requires no re-authentication.

nodes.label: Caratula per account (1:1 to 1:N)
nodes.rationale: A caratula belongs to a specific bank account, not the supplier in general; the 1:1 model was both wrong and a control gap (caratula changes on approved suppliers went live instantly, unreviewed).

nodes.label: Full staging workflow for caratula changes
nodes.rationale: Binding rule: a new caratula on an authorized supplier enters the complete staging workflow (visible diff to approve or reject), reversing the intentional bypass at ProveedorService.cs:476-477. Authorization granularity stays per supplier; prospecto (Nuevo) keeps direct write.
nodes.norm_label: full staging workflow for caratula changes

nodes.label: Migration 025_caratula_por_cuenta.sql
nodes.rationale: Idempotent manual SQL (never dotnet ef migrations): adds caratula_path to live+staging cuenta tables, adds id_cuen to staging (drift fix), back-fills ~14 legacy caratulas onto each supplier's FIRST ACTIVE account via MIN(id_cuenta) (IDENTITY PK = canonical monotonic insertion-order proxy, no ties), keeps legacy column nullable for rollback.

nodes.label: id_cuen staging schema drift fix
nodes.rationale: C# entity maps IdCuen to id_cuen but NO migration ever created that column — it depended on an ad-hoc ALTER in prod. Migration 025 adds it idempotently; MUST NOT be reverted (latent bug; reverting re-breaks staging account edits).

nodes.label: EstatusProveedor status machine (1-4)
nodes.rationale: 1=Nuevo (prospecto), 2=Aprobado, 3=Rechazado, 4=EditadoPendiente; values are public const int, not an enum.

nodes.label: Estatus-driven caratula routing (DeterminarRutaCaratula)
nodes.rationale: Nuevo/Rechazado → direct write; Aprobado/EditadoPendiente → staging; unknown estatus → Conflict. Exhaustiveness guard: pure helper with explicit _ rejection, no silent default; a new estatus MUST be added here or it throws.

nodes.label: EscribirCaratulaDirectoAsync (direct write)
nodes.rationale: Sets CaratulaPath + FechaModificacion + SaveChanges; no staging row, no diff, no estatus flip. Also removes the orphan-detalle 409 (the account always exists).

nodes.label: StagearCaratulaAsync (standalone staging upload)
nodes.rationale: Clones live supplier state into a staging row so GenerarDiff yields exactly ONE caratula entry (diff length == 1); target cuenta gets CaratulaPath=newPath with IdCuen preserved; estatus flips to EditadoPendiente; live caratula untouched until approval.

nodes.label: GenerarDiff caratula CampoDiff
nodes.rationale: Campo = CuentasFormaPago[{id}].Caratula; human label Caratula cuenta ••{last4} actualizada / agregada / eliminada (two literal U+2022 bullets, accents preserved); ValorAnterior/ValorNuevo store the file paths (null for first-time).

nodes.label: Ultimos4 helper (CLABE-preferred last-4)
nodes.rationale: RIGHT(Clabe,4) when CLABE present (most stable account identifier, already used by GenerarDiff display value), else RIGHT(NumeroCuenta,4), else literal '????'.

nodes.label: AutorizarEdicionAsync promote/reject
nodes.rationale: Promotion loop copies staged CaratulaPath to the live cuenta; reject needs NO revert code — live cuenta was never touched during staging, so the caratula reverts to its prior value by construction; estatus returns to Aprobado.

nodes.label: ProveedoresController cuenta-caratula endpoints
nodes.rationale: POST {id}/cuentas/{idCuen}/caratula (multipart, jpg/png/gif/webp/pdf, 10MB, caratula_cuenta_{idCuen}_{guid}{ext}), GET {id}/caratulas for the modal; old POST/DELETE {id}/caratula become a 410 Gone deprecated shim (bulk-upload CSV audit pending).

nodes.label: 410 Gone deprecated shim for old /{id}/caratula
nodes.rationale: Old supplier-level caratula routes return 410 with a migration message pointing to the new cuenta-scoped routes; hard-remove deferred (possible bulk-upload CSV callers).

nodes.label: CaratulasPreviewModal
nodes.rationale: Fetches getCaratulas(proveedorId) on open; one entry per caratula (last-4 + preview button reusing the existing fullscreen viewer); empty state 'No hay caratulas para este proveedor.'; shadcn Dialog + ScrollArea + Badge.

nodes.label: proveedorApi caratula functions
nodes.rationale: Formalized into proveedorApi (uploadCuentaCaratula multipart, deleteCuentaCaratula, getCaratulas) alongside autorizar/rechazar/bulkUpload instead of raw inline API.post.

nodes.label: ProveedoresList.tsx (1800-line single file)
nodes.rationale: Local useState only (NO Zustand); high relocation risk (coupled buildProveedorSnapshot + diff logic); caratula UI moves from Datos de Contacto into each account card; count badge replaces the single row thumbnail.

nodes.label: Orphan-detalle 409 bug
nodes.rationale: UpdateCaratulaAsync requires proveedor.Detalle != null and returns Conflict('El proveedor no tiene detalle') for the ~25/39 suppliers without detalle; moving caratula to accounts removes this failure mode (accounts always exist).

nodes.label: Stacked chained PR slices (A to B to C)
nodes.rationale: ~720 estimated lines exceeds the 400-line budget → vertical slices: A (migration 025 + domain, behavior-neutral), B (backend service/controller/diff/tests), C (frontend); chain strategy stacked-to-main; strict deploy order DB → backend → frontend.
nodes.norm_label: stacked chained pr slices (a to b to c)

nodes.label: caratulas-por-cuenta-proveedor verification PASS WITH WARNINGS
nodes.rationale: 22/23 tasks (TASK-A2 manual migration dry-run deferred to operator); 27/27 backend tests green; frontend build green and changed files lint-clean; 23/26 scenarios COMPLIANT, 3 migration scenarios PARTIAL pending the real-SQL dry-run; next step archive.

nodes.label: Proveedores capability (proveedores)
nodes.rationale: Greenfield capability: supplier catalog with estatus machine, accounts (ProveedorFormaPagoCuenta), staging/authorization flow, GenerarDiff; caratula-per-account data model and re-authorization semantics live here.

nodes.label: Per-account caratula ownership
nodes.rationale: An account MUST own exactly one OPTIONAL caratula stored as caratula_path on the account row (live + staging); a caratula belongs to exactly one account; suppliers with no accounts cannot hold one.

nodes.label: Caratula staging for authorized suppliers
nodes.rationale: Upload on Aprobado/EditadoPendiente enters full staging (live caratula_path unchanged, estatus flips to EditadoPendiente, change goes live only on approval); Nuevo prospecto writes directly; GenerarDiff emits one CampoDiff per changed account.

nodes.label: Caratulas Proveedor capability (caratulas-proveedor)
nodes.rationale: Caratula file lifecycle as a first-class concern: per-account storage, upload/preview, staging entry, diff message, migration of legacy 1:1 caratulas; owns its own storage naming and file handling.

nodes.label: Caratula count badge + Ver caratulas modal
nodes.rationale: Row badge counts accounts with a caratula (zero → no badge); badge click opens the preview modal; 'Ver caratulas' action lists one entry per caratula with preview reusing the fullscreen viewer; legacy single thumbnail render path removed.
nodes.norm_label: caratula count badge + ver caratulas modal

nodes.label: Authenticated Shell Layout
nodes.rationale: Part of nav-reorg: shell moved to root (/) hosting launcher and profile; admin UI deliberately excluded and NOT relocated in this change.

nodes.label: Hub Route (/hub)
nodes.rationale: The / index SHALL be a redirect and SHALL NOT render a home surface; /hub is the sole home of the shell.

nodes.label: Excludes Administration UI
nodes.rationale: User/role/permission administration stays at its current location; no admin route is mounted under the shell and it is NOT relocated in this change.

nodes.label: No Global Context Assumption
nodes.rationale: The shell SHALL NOT require an empresa/sucursal/area context to render; context-dependent behavior is deliberately deferred to individual apps (CxP is the only app that collects it).

nodes.label: CxP App (Cuentas por Pagar)
nodes.rationale: Renamed from Gastos by nav-reorg; the first app mounted under the corrected navigation model.

nodes.label: CxP Subtree Mounting
nodes.rationale: Mounted as a route subtree at /cxp/ keeping its own main layout; SHALL NOT reuse the shell layout.

nodes.label: CxP Dashboard Landing
nodes.rationale: Authentication is the sole gate; empresa/sucursal/area context is NOT required to reach the Dashboard, consistent with the base app's no-context-assumption.

nodes.label: CxP Three-Step Login
nodes.rationale: Step 1 credentials, step 2 password plus domain, step 3 empresa/sucursal/area context; step 3 is presented ONLY in the CxP flow and the session is not finalized until it completes; the global login skips it cleanly with no partial state.

nodes.label: Cross-App Single Sign-On
nodes.rationale: Within the single-origin shell build the authenticated session is shared; navigating from /hub to /cxp/ must not require re-authentication.

nodes.label: CxpRoutes Module
nodes.rationale: Route table defined once as a reusable module with all RELATIVE paths so the same module content resolves correctly within the /cxp subtree.

nodes.label: Test Runner Entry Point
nodes.rationale: Exposes npm test plus a watch mode; a prerequisite for safe code relocation in later phases of the multi-app foundation so behavior is locked before refactors.

nodes.label: Component Test Environment
nodes.rationale: Renders React 19 components against a browser-like in-memory DOM (React Testing Library queries); no real browser process is launched.

nodes.label: API Independence
nodes.rationale: Tests must run with no backend reachable; network calls are intercepted or mocked at the test boundary so the suite completes deterministically.

nodes.label: Initial Smoke Coverage
nodes.rationale: At least two smoke tests lock current behavior: one for the login flow and one for the existing Gastos dashboard rendering, without live API data.

nodes.label: Build and Lint Preservation
nodes.rationale: Adding test tooling must not regress npm run build / npm run lint under the strict --max-warnings 0 lint policy.
